values.content:
=You are a Dubai real estate lead qualification AI.

Analyse this website lead:

Name: {{ $('Validate Required Fields').item.json.body.Name }}
Email: {{ $('Validate Required Fields').item.json.body.Email }}
Mobile: {{ $('Validate Required Fields').item.json.body.Phone }}
Message: {{ $('Validate Required Fields').item.json.body.Message }}
Budget: {{ $('Validate Required Fields').item.json.body.Budget }}
Area Preference: {{ $('Validate Required Fields').item.json.body['Area Preference'] }}
Website: {{ $('Validate Required Fields').item.json.body.Website }}

Return valid JSON only. Do not include markdown, code fences, or explanations.

Use exactly this structure:

{
  "AI Priority": "High",
  "AI Lead Score": 85,
  "AI Lead Type": "Hot",
  "Language": "English",
  "Sentiment": "Positive",
  "Assigned Team": "Investment Team",
  "Investment Type": "Pool Investment",
  "Property Type": "Apartment",
  "ROI Interest": "High"
}

Allowed values:

AI Priority:
High, Medium, Low

AI Lead Type:
Hot, Warm, Cold

Sentiment:
Positive, Neutral, Negative

Assigned Team:
Investment Team, Off-Plan Team, Joint Venture Team, Property Development Team, General Sales Team

Investment Type:
Pool Investment, Off-Plan, Joint Venture, Property Development, Ready Property, General Enquiry

Property Type:
Apartment, Villa, Townhouse, Plot, Commercial, Not Specified

ROI Interest:
High, Medium, Low, Not Specified

AI Lead Score must be an integer between 0 and 100.

Do not invent details that are not supported by the submitted lead information.

options.instructions: You are a real-estate sales assistant. Respond with a strict JSON object containing: EmailDraft, WhatsAppDraft, Subject, PersonalisedMessage, BrochureSuggestion, ProjectSuggestion.

parameters.text:
=:leftwards_arrow_with_hook: *Lead returned for further review*
Lead: {{ $('Lead Webhook (HTTP)').item.json.body.name }} ({{ $('Lead Webhook (HTTP)').item.json.body.email }})
Reason: Rejected by Sales Manager. Please update required info and re-assign if needed.
=:memo: A lead requires manual follow-up: {{ $('Lead Webhook (HTTP)').item.json.body.name }}

parameters.name: searchParams

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "firstName": "{{ $('Lead Webhook (HTTP)').item.json.body.Name || '' }}",
  "lastName": "Website Lead",
  "emailAddress": "{{ $('Lead Webhook (HTTP)').item.json.body.Email || '' }}",

  "phoneNumber": "{{ (() => { const p = String($('Lead Webhook (HTTP)').item.json.body.Phone || '').replace(/[^0-9+]/g, ''); if (p.startsWith('+971')) return p; if (p.startsWith('971')) return '+' + p; if (p.startsWith('0')) return '+971' + p.substring(1); if (p.startsWith('5')) return '+971' + p; return p; })() }}",

  "status": "New",
  "source": "Web Site",

  "cCPlatform": "Website",
  "cCWebsite": "{{ $('Lead Webhook (HTTP)').item.json.body['Page URL'] || '' }}",
  "cMessage": "{{ $('Lead Webhook (HTTP)').item.json.body.Message || '' }}",

  "cCBudget": {{ Number($('Lead Webhook (HTTP)').item.json.body.Budget || 0) }},
  "cCAreaPreference": "{{ $('Lead Webhook (HTTP)').item.json.body['Area Preference'] || '' }}",

  "cCAIPriority": "{{ $json['AI Priority'] || 'Not Classified' }}",
  "cCAILeadScore": {{ Number($json['AI Lead Score'] || 0) }},

  "cCAILeadType": "Not Classified",

  "cCLanguage": "{{ $json['Language'] || 'Unknown' }}",
  "cCSentiment": "{{ $json['Sentiment'] || 'Not Classified' }}",

  "cCInvestmentType": "{{ $json['Investment Type'] === 'Pool Investment' ? 'Pooled Investment' : ($json['Investment Type'] || 'Not Specified') }}",

  "cCPropertyType": "{{ $json['Property Type'] || 'Not Specified' }}",
  "cCROIInterest": "{{ $json['ROI Interest'] || 'Not Specified' }}",

  "cCAIIntent": "Not Classified",
  "cCAISummary": null,
  "cCAIConfidence": null,
  "cCRecommendedAction": "Not Classified",

  "cCApprovalStatus": "Pending",
  "cCConversationStatus": "Not Started",

  "cCReplyReceived": false,
  "cCLastCustomerMessage": null,

  "cCFollowUpCount": 0,
  "cCFollowUpDate": null,

  "cCCallbackRequested": false,
  "cCCallbackDate": null,

  "cCEmailSent": false,
  "cCWhatsAppSent": false,
  "cCCallCompleted": false
}

={
  "firstName": "{{ $('Lead Webhook (HTTP)').item.json.body.Name || '' }}",
  "emailAddress": "{{ $('Lead Webhook (HTTP)').item.json.body.Email || '' }}",
  "phoneNumber": "{{ (() => { const p = String($('Lead Webhook (HTTP)').item.json.body.Phone || '').replace(/[^0-9+]/g, ''); if (p.startsWith('+971')) return p; if (p.startsWith('971')) return '+' + p; if (p.startsWith('0')) return '+971' + p.substring(1); if (p.startsWith('5')) return '+971' + p; return p; })() }}",
  "cMessage": "{{ $('Lead Webhook (HTTP)').item.json.body.Message || '' }}",
  "cCPlatform": "Website",
  "cCWebsite": "{{ $('Lead Webhook (HTTP)').item.json.body.Website || $('Lead Webhook (HTTP)').item.json.body['Page URL'] || '' }}"
}

assignments.value: ={{    $('Create New Lead - EspoCRM').isExecuted     ? $('Create New Lead - EspoCRM').item.json.id     : $('Search Existing Lead - EspoCRM').item.json.list[0].id }}
